text:
michael: Quick sync— we need a compact compatibility approach for the upcoming response-envelope change so partner parsers don't break. goal: opt-in, safe fallback, observable rollback.

anya: Proposal: Accept header for opt-in (Accept: application/redwood.v3+json), plus a lightweight probe POST /v1/client-support to register client_id. runtime chooses envelope path if header present OR probe true OR tenant flag. default: legacy.

leo: Shim design: place a tiny translator in the serializer layer that converts envelope -> legacy flat shape when receiver doesn't opt in. translation must be deterministic and avoid changing semantics. no enrichment, no inferred fields.

michael: Rollout flags: runtime.flags.envelope = off|opt-in|force. start off, then opt-in for SDKs, canary tenants, ramp. include migration.wave tag in telemetry.

ops-bot: Note: added dashboards "envelope.rollout_coverage" and "envelope.fallback_rate". will alert if fallback_rate spikes > 2x baseline.

anya: Telemetry: emit envelope.accept, envelope.fallback, envelope.translate.ms with tags tenant/route/model. sample fallbacks at 2% and accept flows at 100% for visibility.

leo: Automated rollback triggers: per-tenant fallback rate > 3x OR latency.p95 + 25% OR parsing errors uptick -> flip tenant to legacy and page oncall. implement quick-flip script.

michael: SDKs: publish tiny helper that calls probe and sets Accept header; contact major vendor libs with PRs. docs snippet for probe + header: 

curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"client_id":"my-sdk"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/client-support

curl -H "Accept: application/redwood.v3+json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

leo: Testing: golden diffs for envelope vs legacy; stress serializer path; fuzz rw_meta to ensure shim drops unknown keys safely.

michael: Owners: michael (spec + rollout), anya (docs + SDK outreach), leo (runtime + rollback). follow-up Friday 9am once staging metrics land.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/envelope-compat -> staging (build 8392). CI: 48/49 green. :rocket:
